Personally, I regret this investment and wanted to share my experience, since results can obviously vary from person to person.

one_star_reviews.text:
Very Disappointing Experience

We had a very disappointing experience at this Shoppers Drug Mart. We went there on August 26 around 7:45 PM to get photographs taken for our PR immigration application.

The employee who assisted us confidently said that he knew exactly what type of photo was required. We even showed him example pictures and clearly explained that the photos were for an immigration application. We paid $39, trusting that the photos would meet the required specifications.

Unfortunately, when we got home, we noticed that the photos were not properly done and, more importantly, none of the required details were written on the back of the photos. The photos were therefore essentially useless for our application, and the money we paid felt completely wasted.

We returned the next day and spoke with another employee, who told us that if our application was rejected, they could take new photos for $27. We were extremely disappointed by this response. The assistant manager also did not seem to understand the requirements and told us that the details we were asking for were only required for a driver’s licence. This was very confusing and frustrating, especially since we had clearly stated from the beginning that the photos were for PR immigration purposes.

If the staff are offering immigration photo services, they should be properly trained and familiar with the specific requirements before charging customers for the service.

Overall, this was a very poor and disappointing experience. We will definitely not be returning to this location, especially for immigration photos. I would strongly recommend double-checking the photo requirements yourself before paying for this service.

After 15 years in the Canadian Armed Forces and living with PTSD, I expected professionalism and compassion from Insight Psychology. Instead, I found their administration extremely disappointing. Staff did not clearly explain their roles, payment seemed to take priority over my concerns, and my request to speak with management led to an unidentified voicemail. People seeking psychological care deserve better communication and respect. I would not recommend this clinic to anyone, including my own family.

I contacted Insight Psych after our beloved cat of 15 years passed away. My wife and I were experiencing deep grief. My initial contact, by email, was cordial, so I thougtht I found the right place and booked an appointment with a therapist they recommended. The next day, they called and said sorry, they erred and that particular therapist didn't accept couples, so they suggested another therapist who did do couples therapy. The day before our appoinment they called again to apologize saying that therapist also didn't accept couples. So, at one of the lowest points of our life, this is the treatment we received.  The appointment was cancelled, but to add insult to injury, they did not immediately refund the deposit we made, nor did they reverse the insurance pre-authorazation - we only found out about it through the insurance company, who cancelled it after we let them know what transpired.   Just appauling behaviour when they are supposed to be helping guide people through some of their most vulnerable times.

one_star_reviews.text:
** my first time leaving a bad review**

First-time parents  — please read this before choosing a daycare.

This was my son’s first daycare and my first experience as a first-time mom and an immigrant. At first, everything seemed wonderful. My son started there at around 1½ years old.

As he got older, he went through a phase of biting, which, although difficult for everyone involved, is a common developmental behavior in toddlers, especially under the age of three.

Unfortunately, instead of helping him work through this phase, things quickly became negative. My son started crying every morning when I dropped him off. I had to say goodbye to him through the window. I was repeatedly called to pick him up because he had bitten another child, and I was told they could not “handle” him.

I also received emails describing my TWO-YEAR-OLD as “violent” and “aggressive.” (I still have this emails )

Eventually, my son was expelled because they said they could not deal with his biting and that other parents were complaining.

He was TWO years old.

Two years later, I feel comfortable sharing this review because I now have perspective. Thankfully, we found another daycare where the same behavior was handled completely differently. His teachers used books, activities, positive strategies, and worked with us to help him. The behavior improved dramatically, and when he turned three, he simply stopped biting.

But the biggest difference was this:

My son never cried when I left him at the new daycare — not even on his very first day.

That taught me something I will never forget.

To all first-time parents, immigrant or not: listen to your child. Even when they cannot explain with words what is happening, their behavior can tell you a lot.

If your child is consistently unhappy, crying, afraid, or showing a sudden change in behavior when going to daycare, do not ignore those signs. Trust your instincts and ask questions.

Sometimes our children cannot tell us what is wrong.
We have to listen to what they are showing us.

one_star_reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with the service and customer care provided by this establishment. I had ordered custom branded coffee paper cups and PET cups for my small business. The coffee cups turned out perfectly, however the PET cups were coming out inconsistent with each print. The first concern happened when they sent proof cups I paid for without confirming any details/customizations. I believe their rep, Wei, confirmed he sent the proofs to the wrong person, who authorized the prints which is why they were sent incorrectly. They offered a 10% discount for their mistake, which I accepted since I was really happy with the quality of the cups & I understand mistakes happen. I let them know the only issue was the logo being transparent, which they confirmed they will keep everything the same with transparent logo. When my second order came the size of my logo was significantly different/smaller. I expressed that I confirmed the print despite the size being off, because I never had an original proof to reference. Plus I trusted the team would ensure everything was the same except the transparency. I still continued to make another order ensuring I checked all relevant details. The 3rd order came with a completely different colour than the first two. I was told it was due to 10% colour deviation when printing, which is fair, but the colour was significantly off. I expressed that this was my 3rd order now that hasn’t been completed with care and accuracy, I was met with another dismissive response.
I expressed that I was disappointed with their lack of concern given that I made numerous orders. They informed me that because I am too “picky” they cannot fulfill my orders going forward. Fair. I tried to order more coffee cups, which there was never any issue with. They canceled the order within the day. I am not stuck having to find and source a new vendor.

Long story short, their quality is great, but it’s a gamble with each order. Comes out different each time, & now they’re refusing to complete my order for raising this concern. As a business owner, I understand the right the refuse service but in this situation it’s extremely unfortunate when I simply didn’t receive what I paid for AND didn’t receive any notice that they would take me as client until I was ready to make a new order. ( I would’ve started looking for a new vendor from the first mistake had I known this was their customer handling)

I’d also like to highlight that my brand logo is very minimalist and simple. If it was a more complex print I’d understand.

one_star_reviews.text:
I DO NOT RECOMMEND BOOKING THE SLIME BIRTHDAY PARTY PACKAGE

I booked the slime party for my daughter’s 8th birthday because website indicates all is included you just relax

There was a lot of things missing as advertised on their website. I booked this party 3 weeks ahead before the party and it feels that it wasn’t even prepared! Their “full birthday set up” was just plastic table covers and a happy birthday sign that’s it! The supposedly “dedicated party host” didn’t even recognize the birthday celebrant AT ALL and just went straight away to teach the kids how to make the slime. After they were done with the slime she just left the room when it stated on the website “the host run the entire event”. Not even a birthday song for the celebrant.

So many things were not prepared and are missing!

1. There were no scents offered! Host said it’s going to be at the end of each slime but eventually said that it was not available in the middle of slime making.
2. Glitters was only offered on the first set of slime! Host said no glitters for the second slime.
3. Out of 22 slime containers for the kids only 9 had personalized sticker labels on them when as per website it was personalized for every guest! Host said they ran out!
4. There was no music offered in the room!
5. There was no slime pit and sensory play stations offered as stated on the website!
6. The kids slime certificates have 2 sizes! The kids were comparing why the other certificates were bigger/smaller.
7. There was no group photo moment!
8. THE BIRTHDAY CELEBRANTS CERTIFICATE WAS REUSED FROM ANOTHER DATE WHICH WAS JUST CROSSED OUT WITH A DIFFERENT NAME OF HOST INDICATED.

Mind you this party was booked 3 weeks ahead! Over all I can say the host wasn’t prepared at all. It’s a kids birthday party most of them were 8 year olds if you don’t have patience with the kids then don’t be a party host! Description on the website was very deceiving. Take your birthday parties somewhere else. 👎👎👎

one_star_reviews.text:
Really disappointed but I guess I should have read the reviews first. I contacted them for my son and made an appointment for the end of the month. They texted Tuesday and asked if we could come in that Thursday and I said sure. I discovered that I wouldn’t have a way to get to the session and told them before 7am, my husband was supposed to drive us but he wouldn’t be back from work in Toronto in time. I have 2 kids and a disability so it wasn’t feasible. I was told I can’t cancel less than 48hrs before.  I understand needing a cancellation policy but for a business that asks its customers to be vulnerable and trusting  and claims to be compassionate the responses are hostile and lack empathy. I was told I would be charged in full “I know the policy is frustrating but I’m just the enforcer of rules” is what she said. Later they went back on that and said they’d make an exception this time. We hadn’t even been to the location or ever sat down with a therapist so the whole exchange was really unsavoury and I no longer felt confident or safe bringing my son there. I work in a compassionate field too and I’ve owned a small business for 17 years. I get that cancellations are a pain, and if I had just not shown up I understand being charged but this is just bad customer service. I now see I’m not alone in feeling this way and I’ll make sure to do more research before finding the right counselling service for my family. I think it’s interesting that they are able to change appointment times with less that 48hrs notice but their clients aren’t? That’s pretty hypocritical. Whoever is writing this policy should rethink it.

Edit: since posting this review this business has posted 4 positive reviews within an hour. One with the same surname as the owner and the other one from the same woman who booked my appointment.  Pretty shady stuff!

People driving into the centre are repeatedly attempting to make a left turn into the parking lot directly after the traffic lights. The centre needs to clearly inform its students about the proper way to access the parking lot and remind them to follow the road markings and traffic rules. This is happening frequently enough that it should not be ignored.

Mitchell Adult Education Centre needs to address this issue with its students before someone gets seriously hurt or a collision occurs.

Absolutely horrible experience. I would strongly recommend avoiding this store and never visiting it for tire services.

I recently had new tires fitted here, but they were not installed or balanced properly. After leaving the store, I experienced severe vibrations whenever I drove at higher speeds, especially on the highway. This made the entire journey extremely uncomfortable and concerning from a safety perspective.

A trip from Toronto to Windsor that would normally take around four hours ended up taking me almost eight hours because I had to drive at a much lower speed due to the vibrations.

The tire alignment was also a complete mess. After finally reaching Windsor, I took my car to a local mechanic to have everything checked. The mechanic had to properly fix the alignment and setup, which cost me an additional $50 out of my own pocket.

I paid this store expecting my new tires to be installed correctly, but instead, I was left with an unsafe and frustrating driving experience and had to spend even more money to fix their work.

Overall, it was completely worthless and a terrible experience. Please take your vehicle somewhere else if you value your time, money, and safety.

one_star_reviews.text:
We lived here for almost four years, and before renting in this building, I strongly recommend reading the other reviews carefully. Unfortunately, many of the experiences described by former tenants are very similar to ours.

Starting with the positives: the apartment itself was very good — spacious, comfortable and reasonably priced. The area around the building is beautiful and quiet, with nice places to walk. However, the train noise can be extremely loud at night, especially in the summer with the windows open. The location is also quite isolated, and in my opinion, having a car makes a huge difference.

Our biggest problem was not the apartment itself, but the management company, particularly when we decided to move out.

We took excellent care of our apartment. Management had even asked to use our unit for professional marketing photos and showings because of how clean and presentable it was. Before leaving, we also hired a professional painter ourselves to patch and repaint areas where we had mounted two TVs and a mirror.

Despite this, at move-out management wanted to charge us for repainting three entire walls and withheld our security deposit. They then filed a claim against us with the BC Residential Tenancy Branch.

After almost four years as tenants, we had to prepare evidence, photos, receipts and documents and attend a formal RTB hearing simply to recover our deposit. What I found particularly disrespectful was that after withholding our deposit and filing their own claim against us, they did not even attend the hearing.

The RTB ultimately ruled in our favour. Their claim against us was dismissed, and the landlord was ordered to return our entire security deposit, interest and RTB filing fee, which we have now received.

During our tenancy, we also experienced situations where management attempted to pass costs on to us that we did not believe were our responsibility, including arranging for a technician regarding a bedroom light and then trying to charge us for the visit.

I also personally knew several tenants who moved out during the years we lived there and told us about similar issues with move-out charges. This is why I strongly suggest taking the other reviews here seriously.

Another important point is building security. During the almost four years we lived there, there were three break-ins that we were aware of. Fortunately, nothing ever happened directly to us, but people we knew in the building had property stolen or damaged, including bicycles being stolen and car windows being broken. I understand that break-ins and property crime are unfortunately an issue throughout Vancouver and Metro Vancouver, so I am not suggesting this is unique to this building. However, after seeing multiple incidents during our time there, I think it is something prospective tenants should be aware of and consider, especially if they have a vehicle or store bicycles or other belongings on the property.

Would I recommend the apartment itself? Yes. Would I recommend the rental experience under this management company? Unfortunately, no.

If you decide to rent here, know your rights and document everything: photos, videos, inspection reports, emails and receipts. Do not automatically assume a charge is your responsibility simply because management says it is.

I went to this clinic for cosmetic mole and lipoma removal. I’ve had moles removed elsewhere before, and those scars eventually faded until they were almost invisible. However, the entire purpose of the procedure was cosmetic improvement, and my result was the complete opposite. I’m extremely disappointed that I now have to seek additional treatment to flatten and fade scars left by a cosmetic procedure.

Anyone considering mole removal here should ask exactly how the wounds will be closed, what scarring risks are involved, and what assistance the clinic provides when the cosmetic result is poor.

one_star_reviews.text:
I initially came to Specsavers for an eye exam, and my experience during that visit was great. Everyone was friendly, and I had no issues. Since I was also interested in getting contact lenses, I booked a separate appointment for a contact lens fitting the following Saturday morning.

During my first visit, one of the staff members collected all of my insurance information and the information needed for billing, so I assumed everything was already taken care of before my contact lens appointment.

I came back the following Saturday morning for my contact lens fitting. When I was checking in, one of the staff members told me that they would check whether my contact lenses were covered by my insurance. He then told me that there was no place to bill the contact lenses through my insurance and that I could only use a Health Spending Account if I had one.

I was confused because I had previously provided all of my insurance information, and I know that my insurance includes $300 of vision coverage for things such as frames and contact lenses. I politely asked if they were unable to check whether my contact lenses were covered, but I was told that there was simply nowhere to bill them.

If I had known beforehand that they were unable to bill my insurance for contact lenses, I would not have booked the appointment and woken up early to come in for it. What was especially disappointing was the way the information was communicated to me. The staff member’s tone felt rude and dismissive, which made an otherwise positive experience quite upsetting. Take note this person is the one who booked my contact lens appointment during my visit. He even checked the insurance details that time.

I left without proceeding with the contact lens fitting. I understand that there may be limitations with insurance billing, but I feel this should have been clarified before booking the appointment, especially since my insurance information had already been collected during my first visit. I’m a repeat customer from the previous year, when I had a great experience with Specsavers. That positive experience was actually why I decided to come back this year. Unfortunately, after my experience this time, I don’t think I would want to return to Specsavers again. Also, I double checked my insurance details and it covers contact lenses, I guess he just doesn’t want to make an effort.

My doctor gave me a referral to this place to be checked for endometriosis, and my appointment was today. I honestly thought it was going to be helpful, but unfortunately, for me, it ended up being a huge waste of time.

I have never felt so disrespected and dismissed by other women the way I did today. They refused to give me an ultrasound, even though that was what my doctor was requesting. I told them that I’m a virgin and that I’m in a relationship, yet they kept saying I was single and basically told me to come back once I’ve had sex so they could do a transvaginal ultrasound. I explained to them that even trying to have sex is painful for me, but they dismissed that as well.

I’m in constant pain, even when I’m not on my period, and I feel like none of my concerns were actually taken seriously. They also told me that my periods aren’t irregular, despite me explaining that I have PCOS, I have heavy bleeding, my periods are extremely painful, and my cycle is all over the place. Sometimes I’m late, sometimes I’m early, and sometimes I’m very late.

In the end, all they gave me was a referral for bloodwork to check for endometriosis. They also told me to go on birth control, even though I specifically told them that it doesn’t work for me and that I’d rather not take it because it causes me even more issues.

I went there hoping to finally get some answers, and instead I left feeling completely dismissed and unheard.

I strongly recommend to not come here.

one_star_reviews.text:
After two years here, our opinion of Brigil has changed considerably, and unfortunately, our overall experience was negative.

The promotional rent initially made the apartment seem like a good deal, but once the discounts ended, the price no longer felt justified. Our rent was set to increase by nearly $500/month in the third year. We tried to negotiate in good faith, given the changing rental market and the fact that we’ve always been reliable tenants who pay in advance, but management was unwilling to discuss any alternatives. The response was essentially, “You signed the lease, so that’s your problem.”

The building is marketed as “luxury,” but much of it feels quite basic for the price. The positives are the rooftop terraces, AC, and stainless-steel appliances. However, the gym is very limited, there is no proper outdoor pool, and the landscaping is poorly maintained compared with the promotional images. Visitor parking is also frequently full, making it difficult for guests to park.

The build quality is underwhelming: inexpensive-looking cabinets, vinyl flooring, poorly insulated windows, a small basic washer/dryer, and a very basic bathroom. Ventilation is limited, resulting in significant dust buildup. The basement parking and hallways can become damp in summer, and soundproofing between units is poor. The party room can also be a significant noise issue during events.

The location has some advantages, but the busy roads, traffic noise, and frequent congestion around the Champlain Bridge are drawbacks. The lack of convenient sidewalks also makes walking around the area less enjoyable.

The biggest issue, however, is management. We found them rigid and unresponsive when dealing with reasonable concerns, including lease flexibility and moving options. After speaking with other tenants, it seems our experience may not be unique.

We will not be renewing. If you’re considering Brigil, look carefully at the full multi-year pricing structure and lease conditions rather than focusing on the promotional rate. If you value responsive management, flexibility, quality construction, and a quieter location, I would strongly recommend comparing other options first.

Overall, Brigil seems to offer fairly basic apartments with a “luxury” price tag, while the management experience falls well short of what we expected.

What a horrible experience,

Are they friendly? yup, but the communication is horrid, unprofessional and not very knowledgable. The have practicum students working on your project, yeah thats a great idea. not.

I had to write a 4 page letter to point designs just to be herd, this company does not know how to fight for your needs.

I had to involve The War Amps because I was getting no where with this company and point designs that we were working with,
In the end months later, I am told tough luck buddy. So who ever donated to war amps just know i'm throwing $48,000 Closer to $55.000 in the trash, I will be making a tiktok video sharing my story as I do so.

I spent months creating a blender 3d file and made a socket for these companies to co create, they couldn't figure out which way was up or down, back or forward so I crashed out and had to walk away. I as a client should have never been put through all this stress.

I was hopeful that this company would get there stuff together but I'm just a pay check.

one_star_reviews.text:
I was very disappointed with the service I received during my “consultation.”

My fiancée and I called to learn more about starting therapy. First, calling this a consultation is misleading, since we spoke with an appointment setter, not a therapist.

After asking briefly why we were reaching out, the appointment setter immediately tried to book us for four sessions at $235 each with a therapist whose name we had only just heard. We weren’t told who this person was, what their approach is, or that we could review their profile on the website. We were simply asked to commit to a significant sum with someone we knew nothing about.

When I said I’d like to confirm what our benefits cover and get back to them the next day, the response was condescending. I was asked why I had spent 10 minutes on the phone if I wasn’t going to book, and whether I hadn’t read the email explaining what to expect. We never received such an email, only a booking confirmation. We were never asked whether we’d received it, either. When we asked about pricing, that was the moment to check whether we were comfortable committing to four sessions. Instead, I was made to feel that I had wasted their time during a complimentary consultation. At one point, she even tried to put us on hold to take another call.

As a sales manager, I recognize when someone is focused on closing a sale rather than finding out whether a service is the right fit. Wanting to know more before committing roughly $1,000 over four weeks is not unreasonable.

People contact you about personal and often difficult matters. Please consider better training for whoever handles first contact. At a minimum, send prospective clients a link to your specialists’ profiles, or ask whether they’ve had a chance to browse them and whether anyone stands out.

This is my Aug 2026 re-review

I have been coming here for two years and always understood what this place was. The food was cheap, simple, and reliable, and the service was never fancy, but it was at least consistent. Over the last month everything has changed. I have come here four times and each visit has been worse than the last. The server barely speaks, never greets anyone, and is never at the counter. You have to ring the bell just to get her to come out, and when she does, she only says “What do you want” and walks away. The restaurant is not busy, yet food takes twenty minutes, and when it arrives, the quality is nothing like what this place used to serve.

I tried to mention the issues, but she was gone again and I had to ring the bell a second time. There is no customer service, no effort, and no consistency. I do not expect a luxury experience from a place that charges ten dollars for a thali and twelve dollars for a curry, but I do expect decent food and basic courtesy. She’s had glasses before that lasted 2 years with never having any issues with them. For a pair that keeps breaking after 1 month is just ridiculous. I almost feel like the brand she chose is such poor poor cheap quality being sold for $300+ is such a rip off. I understand if the damage is her fault but the screws coming apart and her lenses almost falling out every time is just bad. I’m disappointed with my experience here, particularly with the customer service.

During my previous rental, I had a bad experience because the vehicle I received had dog hair inside, and the interaction with the front desk at that time was not very pleasant. After that experience, I was promised a free one-day rental. I specifically asked about when I could use it and was told that I could come back whenever I wanted and that there was no expiry date.

I returned about a year later to use the promised rental. I was then told that they only keep their records for one year and that they could no longer find any information about what had been promised to me. I was also told that the manager who had dealt with the situation was on maternity leave, so there was apparently no way for them to verify or honour it.

What frustrated me most was the customer service. I spent around half an hour trying to explain the situation, but instead of trying to understand my point of view or find a reasonable solution, I felt like the conversation was mostly focused on explaining why they couldn’t help me.

I was actually prepared to rent a vehicle today, even aside from the free day, but the staff said they didn’t have the authority to book the rental and told me to go online to make the reservation.

I understand that businesses have policies about how long records are kept, but if a customer is promised something with no stated expiry date, there should be a way to document and honour that commitment. A little more effort to understand the situation and find a solution would have made a big difference.

Unfortunately, the overall experience left me feeling that customer service and communication could be significantly improved.

⭐ 1-Star Review — Poor Communication and Lack of Transparency

Very disappointing experience. I would not recommend this service based on my experience.

I hired them for an important immigration matter, but throughout the process I experienced serious problems with communication, transparency, and access to information about my own case.

My biggest concerns were:

Messages and calls were frequently not answered, even when I was asking about important matters concerning my immigration status.
I repeatedly had to follow up just to get basic information about my own application.
I felt that important information about my file was being withheld or not properly explained to me.
I was given information that I later found confusing or inconsistent with the documents and contract.
I was not given clear explanations about fees and deductions, including the hourly-fee issue shown in my messages.
I was left uncertain about the actual status of my immigration application and what I was legally allowed to do.
Important documents and updates were not communicated to me clearly or in a timely manner.
I felt misguided about my situation, and I did not receive the level of professional guidance I expected after paying for legal services.
Communication became especially frustrating when I needed urgent answers and could not get a proper response.
I should not have to repeatedly chase my representative for information about my own immigration file.

The screenshot shows that I specifically asked for an explanation regarding the hourly fee and followed up asking for a reply. Instead of receiving a clear written explanation, I was left waiting and had difficulty getting answers.

When someone is dealing with immigration, their future and legal status are at stake. Clients need honesty, transparency, timely communication, and clear explanations—not unanswered messages and uncertainty.

I am leaving this review so potential clients understand my experience and carefully check their contract, fees, file status, and all advice they receive. I strongly recommend getting important advice and fee arrangements in writing and keeping copies of all communications.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend this service.
